title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Municipality of San Felipe Neri, in the Province of Rizal, to Mandaluyong.

text.en:
The name of the municipality of San Felipe Neri, Province of Rizal, is hereby changed to
Mandaluyong, and the entire territory comprised within the jurisdiction of said municipality shall be known as
Mandaluyong, as provided in this Act.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, November 6, 1931.
